# DELETE /api/v1/admin/hooks/{id}

Delete a system or default webhook and its associated hook tasks

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer (admin required) · **ID:** `ep-095`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| id | path | int64 | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**204** — empty

- **404** — Webhook not found (count=0 after delete)
- **500** — Database error during transactional delete
